title: Comparative study of monoclinic and cubic WO3 nanoplates on NO2 gas-sensing properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22930-22940
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01820J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dang Trung Do, Do Y Nhi Nguyen, Thi Anh Pham, Cong Tu Nguyen, Van Hieu Nguyen
Cubic and monoclinic WO3 nanoplates were synthesized from WO3·nH2O via calcination at 200 °C for 2 h. The monoclinic WO3-based sensor showed the highest response of 1329.3 to 2.5 ppm NO2 at 150 °C.
